detailed_descriptions.en: Fight as part of the human defiance against the relentless Machine Legion. Pick your android prototype class , experiment with powerful gear and upgrade yourself to match the Machine Gods! 1-4 Player Co-Op Mayhem 120+ Weapons with Deep Mechanics Limitless Replayability & Modding! ▩ CO-OP MAYHEM Fight the Machine Legion Solo or in chaotic 2-4 Player co-op! Level your android classes, unlock new loadouts and experiment with new builds every run! Find powerful loot, experiment with many classes, endless load-outs and tons of crazy tech! ▩ NEXT LEVEL GUNPLAY Master the satisfying manual reload system, leverage the unique top-down headshots , now more accurate than ever! A new attachment system allows for even more varied upgrade paths! Weapons can now upgraded to new heights! Weapons can jam and overheat—keep your cool or burn out! ▩ MEET YOUR ARSENAL Explore powerful Faction Arsenals Each weapon can come in many variants, defined by their Faction ▩ DEEP GAMEPLAY: Make hard choices with expansive item and class upgrades and our unique weapon upgrades! Play either as Commando, Riotguard, Breacher, Recon, Demolisher, Machine Hunter, Chrono Trooper... The 10 Classes play very differently, slow, fast, tactical or brawling, choose your style! ▩ NEXT GENERATION MODDING: Our powerful new framework, UniversEdit brings unending new possibilities for you & us! Use our truly next-level modding / content creation tools right within the game: Create and share your own items, abilities, weapons, classes and more within minutes ! ▧ NEW IN SYNTHETIK 2 - vs - SYNTHETIK 1: 4 Player co-op unleashes complete mayhem! Explore more and more varied environments with destruction, physics & full 3D ! Fight the Machine S.A.T Police Force , Chrono Squad and Machine Military and their bosses! The now 10 Classes play more differently, slow, fast, tactical or brawling, choose your style! Master new mechanics such as single shell reload , dual wield and more! A deeper, tailored attachment and item upgrade system allow for more customization than ever! Armor 2.0 enables rear-armor hits, deflections, ricochets and more realistic gunplay! The new Difficulty Directives System allows adding new enemies or other powerful challenges! Create new Classes, Items and Weapons with ease with UniversEdit! Other Improvements: Power Slots - all items can either be set to automatic or manually activated! Weapon Technologies - All weapons come with randomized technology-based perks Faction Variants - Each weapon faction has their own set of unique variants!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Fight as part of the human defiance against the relentless Machine Legion.

Pick your android prototype class, experiment with powerful gear and upgrade yourself to match the Machine Gods!

  • 1-4 Player Co-Op Mayhem

  • 120+ Weapons with Deep Mechanics

  • Limitless Replayability & Modding!

▩ CO-OP MAYHEM

  • Fight the Machine Legion Solo or in chaotic 2-4 Player co-op!

  • Level your android classes, unlock new loadouts and experiment with new builds every run!

  • Find powerful loot, experiment with many classes, endless load-outs and tons of crazy tech!

▩ NEXT LEVEL GUNPLAY

  • Master the satisfying manual reload system,

  • leverage the unique top-down headshots, now more accurate than ever!

  • A new attachment system allows for even more varied upgrade paths!

  • Weapons can now upgraded to new heights!

  • Weapons can jam and overheat—keep your cool or burn out!

▩ MEET YOUR ARSENAL

  • Explore powerful Faction Arsenals

  • Each weapon can come in many variants, defined by their Faction

▩ DEEP GAMEPLAY:

  • Make hard choices with expansive item and class upgrades and our unique weapon upgrades!

  • Play either as Commando, Riotguard, Breacher, Recon, Demolisher, Machine Hunter, Chrono Trooper...

  • The 10 Classes play very differently, slow, fast, tactical or brawling, choose your style!

▩ NEXT GENERATION MODDING:

  • Our powerful new framework, UniversEdit brings unending new possibilities for you & us!

  • Use our truly next-level modding / content creation tools right within the game:

  • Create and share your own items, abilities, weapons, classes and more within minutes!

▧ NEW IN SYNTHETIK 2 - vs - SYNTHETIK 1:

  • 4 Player co-op unleashes complete mayhem!

  • Explore more and more varied environments with destruction, physics & full 3D!

  • Fight the Machine S.A.T Police Force, Chrono Squad and Machine Military and their bosses!

  • The now 10 Classes play more differently, slow, fast, tactical or brawling, choose your style!

  • Master new mechanics such as single shell reload, dual wield and more!

  • A deeper, tailored attachment and item upgrade system allow for more customization than ever!

  • Armor 2.0 enables rear-armor hits, deflections, ricochets and more realistic gunplay!

  • The new Difficulty Directives System allows adding new enemies or other powerful challenges!

  • Create new Classes, Items and Weapons with ease with UniversEdit!

    Other Improvements:

  • Power Slots - all items can either be set to automatic or manually activated!

  • Weapon Technologies - All weapons come with randomized technology-based perks

  • Faction Variants - Each weapon faction has their own set of unique variants!
